qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Kesko possesses strong Finnish retail density via its retailer-entrepreneur K-store model and Kespro foodservice division. However, grocery retailing operates in a domestic duopoly with cooperative S-Group alongside Lidl, limiting grocery pricing power. Furthermore, the conglomerate is weighed down by cyclical Building & Technical Trade (B&TT), resulting in multi-year after-tax GAAP ROIC of ~7.1-7.9%, falling short of the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 7-8% vs 12% hurdle, REJECT). Finnish retailer-entrepreneur grocery model is defensive, but group returns are dragged down by cyclical building/technical trade and cooperative S-Group competition; after-tax GAAP ROIC is chronically below 12%.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~7.1-7.9%. Comparable operating margins contracted from 6.9% in 2021-2022 to 5.5% in 2024 as the European residential construction slump severely impacted Building & Technical Trade (B&TT). Grocery margins are defended but lack independent pricing leverage against S-Group.
